description: Compute a trailing 7-calendar-day moving average of daily signups per platform. The window for date D covers D-6 through D inclusive. Days with no row in daily_signups count as 0 signups (they are not skipped). ma_7d must be NULL until 7 calendar days of history exist for the platform (i.e. for the first 6 days after the platform's first date). Output one row per platform per calendar date from the platform's first date to its last date. Output columns: platform (STRING), signup_date (DATE), signups (INT64), ma_7d (FLOAT64, 2 decimals).

signups.description: Number of signups; rows are absent for days with zero signups

calendar_date.description: One row per calendar date, no gaps

edge_cases: Missing day 2025-06-03 must be emitted with signups = 0 and counted in the average
First 6 days of each platform have ma_7d NULL
Each platform has its own date range and window
Divisor is always 7, never the number of rows present
common_failure_modes: FM2: ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW over sparse data spans more than 7 calendar days
FM3: AVG() over existing rows divides by the number of non-missing days instead of 7
FM4: RANGE BETWEEN with a DATE ORDER BY is not supported in BigQuery without converting to a numeric key (UNIX_DATE)
